close_reason: fixed: query_objects receivedAt sort uses epoch comparison via rfc3339_to_epoch_secs
description: query_objects in MemoryBackend sorts by receivedAt using lexicographic string comparison (mod.rs lines 483-486). When receivedAt strings use mixed formats — some with .mmmZ (from now_utc_string() via Email/set create) and some without (from UTCDate literals like '2025-12-31T00:00:00Z') — the sort order is wrong for same-second emails with different formats. '2025-12-31T00:00:00.999Z' sorts BEFORE '2025-12-31T00:00:00Z' lexicographically (because '.' < 'Z'), so an email created at T+999ms appears earlier than one created at exactly T when sorting ascending by receivedAt. This is distinct from the before/after issue (JMAP-1vdc.14) but has the same root cause: format inconsistency after the sub-second timestamp change.
title: ReceivedAt sort in query_objects breaks with mixed .mmmZ vs Z formats
